subfamily: brandy Old-Fashioned built on cubed ice, after the Codex root recipe; most of the sugar comes from one level tablespoon of yellow Chartreuse
glass: old-fashioned glass (rocks glass, about 300 ml), filled with ordinary ice cubes
_status: v2 (Tomás, round 5). Story: the Carthusians' 2021/2023 cap on Chartreuse (Wren r4). Floc dropped (story left Gascony). Armagnac Old-Fashioned (plan's shape) with yellow Chartreuse as the main sweetener (Codex p. 29: in an Old-Fashioned variation 'the sugar is swapped out for a sweet liqueur'): 15 ml yellow gives 4.7 g of the 6.9 g sugar, rich syrup the rest. Yellow, not green: green's teaspoon is Beside the First's absinthe slot. One tablespoon, not two teaspoons: On Their Behalf's closing measures 'only two teaspoons'. Strength: Armagnac 40% at 60 ml; stronger, Armagnac at 2400/ABV ml + water to 60 ml (proven 43-56%). Sweep: work/outlaw-innocent/mixologist-draft.md Checks.
